summary: All 9 acceptance criteria and 4 edge cases pass. The blame_localizer module correctly implements reverse SZZ: diff-tree for changed files, source extension filtering with exclusion list, unified diff hunk parsing for old-side line ranges, porcelain blame at fix_hash~1, and StrategyHit assembly. Integration in retriever.py is additive (guarded by fix_hash truthiness). RetrievalConfig and prepare_investigation() accept optional fix_hash. 339/339 tests pass. Test coverage includes normal hits, empty scenarios, deduplication, boundary/zero-SHA filtering, and an optional real-repo integration test. Implementation is clean, well-structured, and follows project conventions.
